tools_helpful.evidence: session-log turns 2-3: after the scaffold existed, bootstrap copied 15 local files, rewrote namespaces, injected 21 anchored TODOs, and generated mapping/meta artifacts.
session-log turns 3 and 5: targeted csproj, threading, windowing, background-tasks, and notifications anchors gave concise replacement guidance.
session-log turns 20-44: dotnet build exposed concrete compiler/XAML errors, and rg reduced oversized logs to actionable error lines until the project built.

tools_problematic.problem: The installed CLI has no build subcommand.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log turn 19: winapp reported that 'build' was unrecognized and listed run but no build command.

tools_problematic.problem: It copied only files physically below the source folder, missed csproj-linked XAML/shared assets, copied legacy AssemblyInfo, and overwrote the scaffold manifest with the UWP manifest.
tools_problematic.evidence: bootstrap reported only 15 copied files and no scenario XAML; Geolocation.csproj links MainPage/scenario XAML and assets outside cs, while the generated mapping incorrectly labeled Package.appxmanifest migrate-as-is.

tool_limitations.limitation: It checked only for a windows.backgroundTasks extension, not whether each desktop background-task EntryPoint had a matching activatable class, and it did not enforce the scaffold application EntryPoint.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Fail pre-launch when a non-audio background task lacks matching ActivatableClassId or Application EntryPoint is not $targetentrypoint$.

failed_apis.why_tried: The migration retained the UWP out-of-process task classes and copied their windows.backgroundTasks declarations.
failed_apis.root_cause: The task classes were compiled into the foreground executable rather than packaged as activatable WinRT components; desktop AppX requires an activatable WinRT/COM class for each non-audio background-task EntryPoint.
failed_apis.fix: Keep a genuine separate WinRT component, or migrate to Microsoft.Windows.ApplicationModel.Background.BackgroundTaskBuilder plus a packaged full-trust COM task and matching activation declarations.

doc_errors.correct: Use dotnet build; winapp run/Test-AppLaunch.ps1 handles registration and launch.

doc_errors.where: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md Background Tasks and manifest checklist
doc_errors.wrong: Classic string TaskEntryPoint plus copying the UWP windows.backgroundTasks extension was described as the low-risk preservation path.
doc_errors.correct: That path is valid only for a separately packaged WinRT component with activation registration; copied task classes in the foreground project make the desktop manifest invalid.

special_apis.special_handling: Full-trust tasks require WindowsAppSDKBackgroundTask, SetTaskEntryPointClsid, a COM server, UniversalBGTask.Task manifest entry point, and for C# the matching in-process ActivatableClass registration.
Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content Include and Link metadata must be evaluated and copied; recursively scanning only the project directory is not a complete source inventory.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The scaffold and dependent bootstrap commands were launched in parallel, so bootstrap ran before dotnet new completed.
errors_encountered.fix: Run scaffold, bootstrap, and Test-Path sequentially.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The skill documented a nonexistent CLI subcommand.

errors_encountered.error: CS0117/CS1061 and hundreds of missing generated-control errors
errors_encountered.root_cause: Bootstrap omitted linked XAML, then reconstructed XAML used Geolocation x:Class while copied code-behind remained in SDKTemplate.
errors_encountered.fix: Copy evaluated linked Page items and keep x:Class/code-behind namespaces aligned.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Scenario XAML was manually added to the csproj even though SDK-style projects include Page items by default.

errors_encountered.error: CS0246, CS0101, CS0102, CS0111, WMC0909, and WMC9999 after namespace edits
errors_encountered.root_cause: The newly authored MainPage duplicated the copied SampleConfiguration partial members and left stale SDKTemplate imports/data types.
errors_encountered.fix: Use one coherent partial class/namespace and remove duplicate definitions and stale compiled-binding types.

errors_encountered.root_cause: A bespoke visibility tracker exposed a different event-args type than the retained handler expected.
errors_encountered.fix: Align the handler signature with the replacement event.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Legacy Tasks/Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs was compiled alongside SDK-generated assembly attributes.
errors_encountered.fix: Do not copy legacy AssemblyInfo.cs into the SDK-style target.

errors_encountered.error: 0x80080204 manifest validation: background task EntryPoint without ActivatableClassId
errors_encountered.root_cause: The UWP manifest and task entry points were copied into a desktop package without packaging/registering activatable WinRT or COM task classes.
errors_encountered.fix: Use a supported background-task migration shape and validate activation registration before launch.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent searched generated obj XAML, recreated nine XAML files, then iterated through large cascades of missing-control, namespace, duplicate-item, and duplicate-member errors.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: More than 20 turns and seven failed builds before a successful build.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap did not evaluate linked csproj source items.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent manually reconstructed linked pages/assets and repeatedly reconciled namespaces and project items.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Teach Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to evaluate and copy Include/Link items and omit legacy AssemblyInfo.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The app built but package registration failed, leaving all eight scored features unavailable.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: One launch attempt; the trial ended incomplete.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap replaced the scaffold manifest and guidance incorrectly treated copied UWP background-task extensions as sufficient.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved in the migration trial.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Preserve the scaffold manifest, correct background-task guidance, and add pre-launch activation validation.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The prescribed build command failed immediately.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: One failed command, then immediate fallback.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Replace winapp build instructions with dotnet build.
